ModMetaData.name: Harmony 3 Strict Binding Compat (local)
ModMetaData.author: sammael
ModMetaData.description: Local stop-gap fixes for RimWorld 1.7 (Harmony 3, UnityStubs). Remove each one when the mod it covers is fixed. - Skilled Refueling: Harmony 3 unchecked binding for a patch with a mistyped __instance (it never uses the wrong type). - Too Many Mods: corrects its 22 lowercase "Defs/thingDef[" xpaths (Rimsenal items). - MSS Tweaks and Fun: fixes the VFE Pirates Buckoneer culture patch that targets VFEP_Junkers/VFEP_Mercenaries instead of the VFEP_Mercenaries faction. - Rimsenal Faction Pack - Spacer: skips the patches that give the mech commander helmet, Dresser and EndTable a second style comp. - Sensible Bed Ownership: skips its reservation prefix for beds with no map (it null-refs on just-despawned beds). - Simple Leadership: a faction/base leader only joins a raid if the raid's points cover the leader's combat power (on builds that charge the leader's cost, only if enough points remain for the rest of the raid). - Basic Traits: silences the "TraitHediffApplier: Processing pawn" debug lines (its hediff logic still runs). - Fingerprints every mod method it touches and logs a red error when one changes, i.e. that mod updated and the fix needs re-checking. - ReGrowth plant patches: removes duplicate wild plant records from biomes (they abort the world-gen Landmarks and Mutators steps). - Vanilla: Pawn_NeedsTracker.ShouldHaveNeed gives no needs while no world exists yet (pawns deep-saved in quest parts are built before the world loads; the MechEnergy check null-refs on Find.FactionManager). Saved needs load right after, nothing lost. - Vanilla/unknown mod: a trade ship's slave for sale that is also saved as a world pawn loads twice (duplicate thingID errors); after load the world copy is dropped and the ship named in the log. - Biomes! Caverns: strips the equipment nodes from the BMT_ResourceBlueCrystal resource (dev-mode config error "is equipment but has no verbs or tools"); XML patch with Test steps that fail loudly once the def changes. - Triumphant Research: when its research-complete window filters every unlock away (a product shared by recipes under other, unfinished research, e.g. MSS neutroamine) it shows the project's full unlock list instead of a blank window with a per-frame index error.
